explanation: This function is vulnerable to SQL injection (CWE-89) because .format() embeds listing_tags_table_name, listing_id, and tag values directly into the INSERT query string. Crafted tags could alter the SQL syntax and execute arbitrary database commands. The repair is broken: it attempts to parameterize the table name with %s (which DB-API drivers quote as a string literal, causing a SQL syntax error) and omits the comma in VALUES (%s %s).
